summary: TOYO Co., Ltd filed a Form 6-K reporting a registered direct offering of 4,545,456 ordinary shares and warrants to purchase an equal number of shares at an offering price of $11.00 per unit for aggregate gross proceeds of approximately $50 million. The warrants have an exercise price of $13.20 and a five-year term. The offering was conducted under an effective shelf registration statement on Form F-3. Roth Capital Partners and H.C. Wainwright served as placement agents receiving a 5.50% cash fee. Net proceeds will fund a solar cell manufacturing facility in Texas and for general corporate purposes. This is a routine capital raise, not a special situation.
